response.sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '(blank)' ELSE p.SEX END AS sex, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '(blank)' ELSE p.SEX END), sex_stats AS (SELECT sex, examined_count, examined_count * 1.0 / SUM(examined_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, AVG(examined_count * 1.0) OVER () AS per_sex_average FROM sex_counts) SELECT sex, examined_count, share_of_total, NULL AS combined_total, NULL AS average_share, NULL AS average_above_per_sex_average FROM sex_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'Above-average sexes', NULL, NULL, SUM(examined_count), AVG(share_of_total), AVG(examined_count - per_sex_average) FROM sex_stats WHERE examined_count > per_sex_average HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
